newsitem.title: EGYPT: Palestinian police take Gaza checkpoint - agency.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian police take Gaza checkpoint - agency.

text.p: Palestinian police seized a border checkpoint between Egypt and the Gaza Strip on Saturday morning after Israeli police stationed there fled the area, the Egyptian official news agency MENA said.
"The Palestinian police force...raised their flag on the checkpoint," the agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), said in its unsourced report.
"Egyptian troops took into custody eight Palestinian and Israeli soldiers and officers who entered Egypt to flee the fighting," MENA was reported as saying.

Fifty-four Palestinians and 14 Israelis have been killed in clashes that erupted on Wednesday after Israel decided to reopen a tunnel near al-Aqsa mosque, Islam's third holiest site, in Arab East Jersualem.
